title: Unit Event — On Your Feet

meta.Outline: After learning the truth behind RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD are more determined than ever to surpass that legendary night. The group decide to do what they can for the time being, but Kohane's thoughts linger on her former mentor Taiga.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent work.
Then, on to the next page...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've made my decision...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm done wondering.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show you guys what things look like from on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can still feel that fire burning right here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to see what it's like. Beyond Nagi and her team's dream... With An. With everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Now do you understand?
This is what you're all up against.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The way Taiga sang really was unbelievable...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was so shaken that I couldn't even sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It'll take more than just skill to surpass RAD WEEKEND. But we still need to reach his level... Otherwise, I'm afraid that we won't be able to get anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(How do we overcome this hurdle...?
No, more like an impossibly high wall...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (At the same time, we know we can't let that get us down.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because we've already made our decision...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's do it.
This is our real starting point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're gonna get even better.
We're gonna get Arata, Kotaro and EVER back...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I guess we need to start discussing what to do next.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do we need to do to put on an event that can surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Or rather, what specific steps can we take to make that a reality?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not just about having the skills to do it. We need to form strong connections not just between us, but also with the crowd. I thought I already understood that, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was her swan song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Nagi's swan song... She was so loved by the people of this city.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still have no idea how we're gonna top that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I finally understand why that event was as mind-blowing as it was...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we're standing here today because that night happened. That's as true as it's ever been.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess we just gotta start checking off each box.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because right now, we don't have the skills or the friends we'll need.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll have to face those shortcomings... And think about what steps we can take, like Toya just said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right. We can't stop now.
We need to keep trying things as we go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Bringing everyone back together.
Tono, Mita and all of EVER...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really don't know if what we'll have to say is gonna convince them to try again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I do know for sure that we need to tell them. About Nagi, about us and about our future.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Agreed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If they hear about why RAD WEEKEND happened, then they might just be willing to come back around again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think our chances of success are zero.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were able to make it this far because we all pushed each other to do better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also believe that we should try talking to them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, that may be easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't mean to spoil the moment...
But it's very difficult to regain lost confidence.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was under fairly different circumstances, but I've been down that path. I sort of understand how they feel...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And why it caused them to give up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's tough to find the will to stand back up and fight after you've convinced yourself there's no point...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I also know how that feels...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And the way he sang. He was a monster...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He's right. The way Taiga sang... It scared me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We couldn't hold our own against that...
And even if we'd managed to, RAD WEEKEND is something even further ahead...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I understand why someone would feel totally helpless after that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really regret what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(If only I could sing better...
If only we could've convinced the others to stay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, stop...
There's no use crying over spilled milk.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Right now, we need to think about what we can do moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I agree that it'll be hard for them to come back.
And... I don't think there's any guarantee that us talking to them will make that happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But at the very least, I wanna tell them about what happened to Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, after coming this far together, we owe it to them. They have a right to know.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree completely...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And there is a chance of them coming back, no matter how small.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try seeing if they'd be willing to sit down and talk with us somewhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thanks, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That just leaves our giant skill gap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be honest, I doubt we're going to find the solution to this problem anytime soon either...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It's not something we can fix here and now, anyway. This is gonna take us a while to figure out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We wouldn't be wondering if we already knew the answer...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If no method is presenting itself, we'll just need to also be thinking about this issue while we continue our practices.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our first step should probably be to secure more time together. Would that be a problem for anyone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That time can be used both for longer practices and for us to brainstorm our plans going forward.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I also need to do what I can...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to find the time and devote it all to singing!)
bgm_area00003
A few hours later
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry.
I was asking my teacher about committee business and it ended up taking longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
But what committee business were you asking about...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I asked to see if there's some way for me to take care of my duties during lunch in order to give myself more time to practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting...
Seems we're all on the same wavelength.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi and I also had discussions along similar lines today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The other hall monitors were happy to hear me out. Same goes for Toya and the library committee. I didn't think it would be this easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That's great, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As for me, I quit my job.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What?!
Just like that...? I didn't realize you could leave on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Normally, I'd have to put in my two weeks... But my manager's always been rooting for us. He even heard through the grapevine how we lost to Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, after I told him that I wanted to focus on music more, he said, “Go get 'em! I believe in you!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...
He sounds like such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I won't be helping out at the cafe for the foreseeable future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, and your dad's okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup.
He said, “That's fine. Don't mind us.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly felt a little relieved...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, whenever I see him or any of the locals, all these emotions begin stirring up inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, wait! I'm sorry...!
I don't hate them or anything for what they did!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad and I had a talk afterwards...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, I should probably be getting ready for bed.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Please give me another chance to apologize.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you about Nagi passing away. I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You better be...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, you never let it show at all...
You even said that she might come back someday...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You and the others were all just respecting her last wishes... Fine, I get that. Still...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I had trouble letting go in the end...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You're right.
Because we'd known each other since we were kids, I didn't want to disrespect her memory.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Also, as an artist, I wanted to see what the next generation she was talking about would be capable of.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
And...
I know this will sound like an excuse...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But as your father, I didn't want you to let go of your dream...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, my actions have caused you a lot of pain...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Which is why I'm genuinely sorry, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't think that I'm gonna forgive you just because you're apologizing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I knew then that she was gone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I probably wouldn't have been able to sing the way I wanted...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Which means...
I might've never met Kohane or Akito or Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm not forgiving you guys for what you did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't regret walking this path. Not one bit...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
An and her dad had a chance to talk things out.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, in any case...
We have more time to sing now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can to make the most of every extra minute.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right!
Oh, actually, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You contacted Tono and everyone the other day, right? Can you tell us what happened after that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I tried contacting them...
But I only heard back from Okazaki.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And he replied, “We need time to settle down and think about what just happened.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, we'll just have to keep trying with Arata and the others as we go! For now, let's focus on practicing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna warm up a little and then head over to MEIKO's place, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I know everyone there's already done quite a bit for us lately, but we should go ask to see if we can borrow her cafe again...
One hour later
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you for agreeing to help us again today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent start!
Try to keep that up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She sounds very motivated again today.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She seems to have a clear image of how she wants her voice to be heard.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We've made our decision!
This is our new starting point!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have to remember what I felt...
During our third event, and when we faced off against Taiga...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh wow.
Looks like Kohane's bringing her A game!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Akito, why don't we try to do the same?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes.
Let's do just that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He's singing with a lot of power...
I need to do the same.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I know how you feel. So, why don't we also get started?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Rin, Len!
Could you lend me a hand again?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want you to pay close attention to how these two sing. Think about where they expend energy or refrain and try to recreate that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll do just that!
Thank you both for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem!
Ready?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There...
I fell behind you again, Miku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But I'm not done yet...!
Let's go one more time!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's the spirit.
I'll go as many times as you want.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone sounds really motivated...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(There's no point in thinking about that.
I have to focus on what I'm doing now... I need to do much more...!)
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
But I'm starting to hear fatigue in your voices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So am I. It's getting late, so why don't we call things here for now? We wouldn't want your families to worry.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, it is getting late...
I gotta get home!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to keep practicing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kohane, you shouldn't push yourself so hard. Overdoing it is only going to backfire.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's right. Knowing when to take breaks is also important.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, you're both right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, MEIKO, thank you very much for letting us borrow your cafe again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. It's always my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll see you all again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Toya?
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
Soma, Tono's partner... He just sent me a message...
The next day
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do you think Soma's like...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You two haven't met him yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, we never got a chance to go with Arata to the hospital since stuff kept coming up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
As for what Soma is like...
He's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Friendly, easy to talk to...and clearly loves music very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure you two will also enjoy meeting him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was a little worried since we're coming along on such short notice. But I'm really excited now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too.
Also...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hope we can find out how Arata's doing. Soma might still be in contact with him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...
It'll be nice to sit down and talk with him.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Oh, hey.
Isn't that Vivid BAD SQUAD...?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Didn't Taiga totally demolish them the other day?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: Yeah, everyone's been talking about that battle. Winning in style's one thing, but that was pretty mean of him...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I really thought they had a chance against him. Guess this means no one's ever gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No one's ever gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course they'd think that...
I mean, there was just that big of a skill gap between us and Uncle Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
In any case, let's go...
We don't have time for this right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I mean, this is sorta what they get for going around saying they're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line: I know, right? Did they really think that they could become even more legendary than Taiga and his team?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You kids get your kicks laughing at the people who try?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Huh?
You talkin' to us, gramps?

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
Crap...!
That's the owner of Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Young Local Musicians
rows.Line:
What?! We, uhh...!
W-We're sorry!!!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
...
I'm guessing you heard from Ken?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yeah, he said he told them everything.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I guess this is it...
About time we all got our comeuppance, eh?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Nagi's wishes were just part of it.
We put a whole lot on An's shoulders.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: We did...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: You know...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
I feel awful about what we did to her.
At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: If An has come to terms with Nagi's last wishes... I can't help but feel excited...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: There isn't much us old folks can do for her and her friends. We should stand aside and let them walk down the path they've chosen...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
No gawkers here. I think we're far enough away now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess everyone really is talking about our battle against Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kotaro...!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kotaro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Mita!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito...? Wait, you're all here...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We haven't seen you since then...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you get my message...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I was gonna reply, but then my phone broke...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Sorry... I'm busy, so—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait.
There's something we need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After that, my dad came over to tell me the whole truth about RADder and Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Including how RAD WEEKEND happened...
And why they wanted to do it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hearing that story made me want to stand back up...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kotaro, I want you to hear it as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, so... Would you mind waiting to make up your mind about us and RAD WEEKEND until you've had a chance to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Please...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I can't help you guys...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Kotaro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Damn...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Mita...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How can we get everyone to sit down and listen to what we heard...?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Also, if...
Even if we manage to outdo Taiga someday...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: I'm having a hard time seeing us surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What Taiga said...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Did he mean we shouldn't chase after dreams we can't possibly achieve...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If we can get better, and convince them we really do have a chance at surpassing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They might come back then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree with Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we all felt totally powerless that day...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, imagine if we got as good as Uncle Taiga. That should convince the others that we have what it takes to surpass RAD WEEKEND. That it's possible to go higher.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If we can do that, our chances are gonna be a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND.
Together. Them included.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But right now, nothing we say is gonna carry any weight. We won't be able to convince them so easily...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. It doesn't matter how long it takes. Let's find ways to improve and ask them when we're ready.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In order to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time.
We need to hurry or we're going to be late for our meeting with Soma.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's go.
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry we're late.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Hey, Aoyagi! Welcome.
I know this was sudden, so thanks for dropping by.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's been too long.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, it isn't much, but we brought you a gift. We hope it's to your liking...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You're so old-fashioned.
You really didn't have to since I asked you guys to come here.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But thanks! I appreciate the gesture!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you!
I'm Toya's teammate, An Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...!
My name is Kohane Azusawa!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hey, thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I'm sure Arata and Aoyagi have already told you about me, but I'm Soma Miyata. It's nice to meet you both.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I got really excited when he said that you two would also be coming! I was hoping that we'd get to talk at least once!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, thank you for having us!
It's great to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, umm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These guys were right! You seem totally different from Arata! He acts all cool and suave, so I thought you'd have a similar feel...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Haha. Yeah, we are pretty different.
But what if I put it this way? How would you feel if there were two of him?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Two of him? Yeah, you may have a point there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So this is Tono's partner...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They were right. He seems like a really cheerful person, and easy to talk to...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, Aoyagi, I need to ask!
How amazing was that track I sent you the other day?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was very intriguing. Its overall composition was quite unique.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I know, right?! I was totally blown away when I heard it for the first time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I relistened to it a number of times and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, guys, quick question...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hm? What's up, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When did you and Toya become so close?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I guess Aoyagi hasn't told you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
I was told to keep it a secret.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A secret?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yes. One thing led to another and I ended up teaching Aoyagi how to make his own tracks for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How to make his own tracks...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't expect it to be used during our upcoming event, but I actually made my own track...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is this what you've been busy with lately, Toya? Were you working on this song?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I asked someone for help when it came to actually writing this song, and I really couldn't have done it without them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ah...
So Soma was the one helping you out.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Though to be fair, there really wasn't much I could actually teach Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, sorry, we got pretty off topic there. Let's return to why you're all here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why we're all here...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah. I asked you all to meet with me today because there's something I need to tell you about Arata.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
He stopped by the other day.
And he didn't look too good...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He told me what happened to you guys. That must've been rough for everyone involved...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So, Soma...
Where is Tono right now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I tried contacting him, but he hasn't responded to me at all...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I see...
Yeah, that guy. He really should've said something before leaving.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Leaving...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He's gone. He left the city...
A few days earlier
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Alright, this track's coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
(It's become a lot better...
It sounds much more balanced. I think I've got a good grasp on that now.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: For today, I'll keep working on it for a little while longer and...
Soma, you there...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
(Whoa, that was close!
He didn't see what I was working on, did he...?)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Don't scare me like that, Arata! Couldn't you have called ahead or—

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You don't look so good...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I'm giving up on trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What are you saying all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Seriously, what happened...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We battled against Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: And he showed me just how hopeless I am. No matter how hard I try, I'll never be able to sing like him...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
It's not just that...
That event...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
RAD WEEKEND...
Nagi fell desperately ill, and it was meant to commemorate her life.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
What...?
Her life...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right...?
I thought she was overseas doing...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it either at first.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
But it's true...
Taiga said so himself.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: (That night really was something else...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: (It was so electric that I didn't know what was going on at times. All I knew was that I was seeing something legendary...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: (But that makes a lot of sense...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
(Nagi was at the center of it all.
Everyone wanted to honor her life...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Arata...
I understand what you're saying.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Surpassing the event that Taiga and everyone put on to commemorate Nagi's life won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But let me ask you this...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You're not the kind of person who gives up after hearing something like that. If people say it's impossible, you set out to prove them wrong...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You wanting to give up has to mean...
What else happened...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: What else...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Nothing. Nothing at all...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In any case, I'm done chasing after this dream.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I need to get away from this city for a while.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I need time to think about what I'm going to do with myself.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Arata, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I...see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I haven't heard back from him since.
Seriously, the nerve of that guy...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Soma...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, that's why I asked you all to meet with me today...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You guys know what happened to him, right?
Would you mind telling me...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, Arata, let me ask you this. Who are you really singing for?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're not trying to make Soma's dreams come true. You can't face the pain of having lost him, so you're just clinging to his dreams.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I wasn't able to respond...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: All I had to say was, “Taunt me all you want! I'll keep carrying his dreams!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Tono wanted to carry Soma's dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But...
Are we in a position to talk to him about that...?)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Okay...
So something did happen.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
My bad, I take back what I said!
Please forget that I even asked!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I sort of already knew what I have to do. I need to ask Arata about this myself...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, I'll stop badgering you guys about him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're really sorry...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Don't be.
For today, I'm just glad that I got to see how you guys are doing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He looked like the life had been drained out of him, so I was worried that you would be feeling the same way.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I feel a lot better now after seeing your faces. You guys haven't given up, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
We still plan on surpassing RAD WEEKEND no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys really are tough...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, you give us too much credit.
We were just as shocked...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we found a reason to not give up...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: A reason?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes.
It's a bit of a long story...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
The next generation...
That's what Nagi wanted...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes. Because she was willing to place her faith in us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want us to surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what it's like beyond their dream.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Thank you for telling me about yourselves and Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: As sad as I am about Arata's decision, maybe this is the way things are meant to be...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He worked himself to the bone for me.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: If this is what it takes to set him free...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I didn't mean to get all sentimental.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Good luck, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Thank you very much for telling us about what happened with Tono.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, it was my pleasure.
Thank you for telling me about Nagi and RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's starting to get dark out.
Get home safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We will. Now, if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: They really are a tough bunch...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
I didn't give Aoyagi a proper apology...
After he helped me make this...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: To think he's never gonna sing this song now...
A few minutes later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm glad Soma let us know what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To think that Tono may never return to this city...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Isn't there any other way...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
All we can do is try to get better...
But we don't have any good ideas for how to do that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know...
I feel like we're at a dead end.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But all we can do now is try even harder...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just try and try...
And believe that our hard work will eventually be rewarded...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're definitely in a tough pickle...
Even just today, we've been through a lot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, what if we stopped somewhere to take a break? Something sweet might help take our mind off things.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I agree.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good evening, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: None of you look very happy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You just went to visit Soma at the hospital, right? What did you all talk about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, um... We talked about Arata.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: According to Soma...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
It's unfortunate to hear that he's left the city.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's sad since we all thought your greater group was doing so well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our group...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is so frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What I mean is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I agree with KAITO...
I thought we had a good thing going with Tono and the others...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We all worked so hard...
And our third event ended up becoming a big success.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really thought we could surpass RAD WEEKEND with them by our side.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And yet, I...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't do anything that time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My legs collapsed under me. I felt so powerless...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That time...
If only I hadn't given up...
If only I sang with everything I had...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Things might've turned out differently...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We might've been able to get the others to stay. Even just one of them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga's someone who performs all around the world... It only makes sense that he was able to defeat us so easily...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I can't help but feel...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really frustrated.
If only I did something different that time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, I know there's no use crying over spilled milk...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I see. Kohane's...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've changed so much, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've changed...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, you have.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You used to be such a timid girl, but you're openly expressing how frustrated you are now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I doubt the old you would've said that about losing to someone as formidable as Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After spending so much time singing with and against people from that city, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's clear that you have quite a bit of confidence in your singing abilities now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Singing has become part of your identity.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Part of my identity...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I believe your frustration stems from you taking your craft as a singer so seriously and wanting to get even just a bit better than you are now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't ever let go of that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because I'm sure it'll help you discover the next path you need to go down.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm in full agreement with Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know you all lost quite a few things because of what happened with Taiga.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think this is the perfect time to take a step back and see what you have left to work with.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because I think what you've gained until now far exceeds what you've just lost.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What we've gained...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, you have a point...
Not too long ago, I didn't even have a good understanding of my own feelings. But now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I found a new dream, and was able to tell my dad how I really feel in my own words...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'm still not very good at it, but I've even learned how to turn my feelings into new songs.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. And me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The old me was so caught up in his own problems that he couldn't see what was going on around him sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But now, I see things more clearly.
I'm better at not losing sight of what's actually important compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it's all probably because I know I have good teammates around me now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: As for me, I met the best partner and best team ever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've been able to experience so many new feelings and sensations because of that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And because of you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm standing here today. I was able to make it this far...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You've all gained so much during this journey.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(He's right...
That includes me. I've also made a lot of discoveries along the way.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But not entirely under my own power.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have all of you to thank...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Miku, you guys...
Shinonome, Aoyagi, An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I am who I am now because of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm here because you all stayed by my side. You watched over me and gave me so much support.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel exactly the same way, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...
We probably wouldn't be standing here right now if we hadn't met that day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
That also includes Ken, the others from our group...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All the locals, Nagi, who left us RAD WEEKEND, and...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And I'm curious to find out just how far she can go if she's given that chance.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You want to really know what RAD WEEKEND was like, right? Then, you should be standing up there and not down here.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: How about it, Granny? Mind letting them on stage?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nice singing! Keep it up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's right.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He taught me what's most important when it comes to singing, and how hard it's going to be to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He was my teacher.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which is why I feel both grateful and frustrated at the same time right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I...
Airport

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Thanks for the ride.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You know I'm not your personal driver, right?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, quit being so stuck-up. You've got time until you have to open the cafe, right? Don't leave me hanging now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Acting as you please as always...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I mean, what you did was pretty mean.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hah. Like you have any right to talk.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, how's An been?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She's accepted what Nagi wanted, and she's decided to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, does that mean you've put all this behind you now?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: No, not yet.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: There's still something I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I see.
I guess Nagi's still got a hold over you.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Not her.
I'm talking about my duty to An and the next generation.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They're probably at school now, right...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Being a student's so tough.
You never have enough time to really sing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You're joking, right?
Only people who actually studied get to say stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Haha. True.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to head back.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright. Later, Ken.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Your coffee wasn't half bad.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I still have time, but I guess I should start making my way over now that I'm checked in...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The folks at that record company are probably gonna chew me out when I get back.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I guess I have that girl to blame...)
se_event_onyourfeet_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What's she doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're all here...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It's the middle of the day.
Shouldn't you be in school...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We're cutting class!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Whoa, hold on...
Someone's been a bad influence on you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You'll be boarding your flight soon, right? We want to tell you something before you do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I heard everything about Aunt Nagi.
About her, about Dad, about you. All of it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Looks like you've all made up your minds.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have. We're gonna answer her call...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean I'm forgiving you...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course, I know telling you to apologize would be pointless, especially since you never apologize to anyone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So... We're gonna see what's beyond you guys' dream!
That's what'll get under your skin the most, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We're serious about this.
And we don't care how long it takes us...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, just wait for us over there.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright... I'll be looking forward to seeing you all again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for everything you've done!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You taught me so much about so many different things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Like what it means to sing...
Taking us to COL because I didn't actually see RAD WEEKEND when it happened...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And our third event went as well as it did because of what you taught me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you showed me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This frustration that I feel.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I...
I'm going to move forward without forgetting this frustration.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't care how long or scary the road up ahead is! I'm not stopping!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to find an even greater purpose for singing than you, perform even better than you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and see what's waiting for us on the other side!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Knock yourselves out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We will!
se_event_onyourfeet_2023_001
Several dozen minutes later
Airport

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There he goes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm really glad we came to say goodbye. I feel so much better now that I've gotten everything off my chest...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
The way you stuck it to him was really cool, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, all things considered, you did a pretty good job for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
However, we have to make what you said a reality now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right! So, let's do just that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, we did end up cutting class...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right...
Everyone's probably taking that English quiz right about now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You seem anxious, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I know how you feel. I also feel kind of bad about everyone else being at school while I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really?
I mean, missing one day isn't a huge problem or anything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Especially you two, Akito, Shiraishi.
How do either of you expect to make up for the time you've lost today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uhh... I'll...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-It'll all work out in the end, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm going to need to explain why I wasn't at school today to my parents...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not sure what's going to happen after I tell them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right... Your parents might not take this lightly...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What if they stop letting me practice or do anything with you guys...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-If they do, we'll go apologize together...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
We'll be there if it comes to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: At the same time, Azusawa, you came because you felt that you had to be here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Even if they do punish you...
I'm sure your parents will understand if you explain how you felt, like you did just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
I'll try doing that when I get home...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, what should we do now...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even if we hurry back to our schools, we probably won't make it in time for any classes. So, we could head over to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, why don't we head over to Weekend Garage...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I kinda want to tell my dad what we just told Uncle Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we haven't seen Ken in a little while since we've been meeting in SEKAI recently...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, let's go!
A few hours later
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place looks eerily clean...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
It's like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Dad...!
The sign out front still says, “Open”. What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, whoops...
I forgot to flip it around.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Also, you're back already...?
You're not usually back from school this early.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Or were you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...!
I suggested to everyone that we go see Taiga at the airport before he left...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You suggested it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I-It's not your fault, Kohane!
It's mine for saying that it was a good idea!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sorry for skipping school...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
School's where students are supposed to be...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
But there's no use crying over spilled milk.
And I'm sure you all had your reasons...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, you really should've asked first. I wouldn't have said no if you could justify why you were going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Got it...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: By the way, that goes for all of you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, so, Dad...
Where'd all the chairs and tables go...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm doing some cleaning.
I was just putting away all the cups...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Putting them away...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: That's right. I'm thinking about closing this place down for a little while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Closing down?! What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: B-But why...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, I'm going to help you do that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You've all made your decision.
Which is why I'm going to do what I can to honor that.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's what I owe you for keeping the truth from you for so long...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm also doing this for myself.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Just like Nagi placed her faith in the next generation, I want to see what the future has in store for this town...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Which is why I'll be closing this place down for a while.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I thought about still running breakfast and lunch services, but...
I'm not one to do things halfway. The shop's going to be closed for a while.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But... What about Mom...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I've already spoken to her about this.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The topic has also been on her mind for some time now. Her words were, “Go. You have a duty to fulfill.”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We still have some money saved up from when I was making music. We should be able to get by for a little while.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Plus, I'm more of a player than a coach. I've never been a good teacher, so I need to be prepared to put in as much time as I can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're serious about this, Dad...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm going to take this opportunity to teach you all everything I can.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: In other words, I'm betting on you using all that I have at my disposal.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, you're going to have to fully commit yourselves to singing and staying in shape. I'll be running you all ragged until you can't stand any longer, every single day.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you prepared for that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're going to teach...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, that's a no-brainer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. There's only one answer to that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're on, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Okay then.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: As of today, this establishment is closed.
se_event_onyourfeet_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's all going to start again...
Here, at Weekend Garage.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If An's dad is saying that much, I'm sure practice with him is going to be really demanding.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I might even feel scared and want to give up at times...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for me to go back in there...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No. I already made up my mind that I'd come listen to that song again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I've got to open the door!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've felt scared by more than a few things along the way.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even so...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've been able to see and experience so many new things because I worked up the courage to open that next door.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Some being really happy things.
So, despite being scared, I've always been glad I took the leap.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which is why I think I'll be okay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, Miku and the others said so.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've changed so much, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Singing has become part of your identity.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This frustration I'm feeling. It fuels me now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's going to propel me forward!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As impossibly high as this wall is, we'll find a way over it. Together...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nothing.
It's just... You looked really excited just now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's because I am...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, let's do it!
We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Nothing else I do is ever going to be this fun or exciting...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I decided to open the door to this place that day. So unbelievably glad...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We're starting over! Right here!
In the place where my heart raced when I heard An sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do our best, everyone!
